en: A black‑and‑white postcard photograph showing a large arched steel bridge crowded with pedestrians, cyclists, and early 20th‑century automobiles. A small airplane flies overhead. People line both sides of the roadway, suggesting an opening celebration or major event on the new bridge. At the bottom, printed text in Dutch identifies the location as Nijmegen and references the new Waal Bridge.
